description: Recipe: a spring that throws small robots up and back (12 Al a copy). On the catwalk the fall hurts. Press Tab in an intermission to build one where you stand.
Recipe: a scarecrow that pulls a few nearby robots off the silo (6 Al a copy). On the catwalk it pulls climbers; on a roof, Lobbers.
Recipe: a scrap wall robots must smash before going on (8 Al a copy). On the catwalk it turns climbers the other way.
+25% construction speed per level: a 10 s spring builds in 8 s.
+15% launch power and -12% reset time per level.
+20% lure radius and one more robot held per level.
